issue.title: [YSQL] Tablet servers page shows incorrect tablet count for colocated tables

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body: Tablet servers page (http://127.0.0.1:7000/tablet-servers) shows incorrect count for user tablets while using colocated tables - it's counting the same tablet for every table that's colocated.

issue.title: [Phase 3][Colocation] Tablet Server UI shows only colocated parent table

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [[DB-393]](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-393)
Tablet Server `tables` page only shows the colocated parent table (see screenshot below). We should extend this to show all colocated tables (and hide the parent table since it's an internal detail?).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15746068/74767735-45283600-523c-11ea-825e-b8cede285546.png)

issue.body:
Fix for issue: https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/3674

Test plan: 

1. run yb-ctl to create a cluster with RF=1
2. Create a database with colocated=true and three colocated tables
3. Go  to  http://127.0.0.1:7000/tablet-servers
4. One should see...
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62734812/84977238-b7236580-b0de-11ea-98f0-e6818c083b99.png)
